_comment: TDD M4 anthropic-off scope guard: enabled thinking requires a same-protocol route; strict 400 in both modes (retained, never downgraded to loss).
name: m4_reasoning_anthropic_off_chat_enabled_strict
config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.chatup]
dialect = "openai-chat"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "upstream-secret"

[[models]]
name = "bridge-chat"
provider = "chatup"
model = "gpt-4o-mini"
